Research, engineering & building in public
About me

I learn best by building and testing.

I’ve spent the last three-plus years working around drones—from design and fabrication to flight operations and autonomous systems.

I’m completing my B.Tech in Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering at Shri G. S. Institute of Technology and Science (SGSITS), Indore. My work spans mechanical design, embedded electronics, flight-controller integration, and practical UAV testing.

I’m especially interested in what happens when a drone can’t rely on GPS. Through my venture, Holdovers, I’m developing a navigation system that combines onboard sensors and computing to support autonomous flight in GPS-denied environments.

I’m a certified drone pilot, and my experience in the field has helped me understand the practical challenges behind the technology I’m working to improve.

MY VENTURE · HOLDOVERS

Making autonomous flight more reliable when GPS isn’t available.

I’m building Holdovers around a practical problem I’ve encountered through drone work: autonomous systems need reliable navigation even when GPS cannot be used. Our approach combines onboard sensors and computing to estimate movement and support autonomous flight.

We’ve completed our proof of concept and are now moving towards advanced prototyping, integration, and testing in a relevant environment.

Current status: PoC completed; prototype development and validation are ongoing. Performance claims will be updated as testing progresses.
